title: I'm sure we all share something in common..

classification.question_topic: Asking others to list personal attributes/background traits to see what Mall World dreamers share in common; notes spouse does not have these dreams
classification.skip_reason: No specific dream narrative, locations, events, or spatial/temporal details are described—post is a prompt for demographic/personal commonalities.

meta.author_theory: What it is, we may never know but the fact that not everybody has these dreams is telling imo. For example, my husband does not visit Mall World in his dreams.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post contains no phenomenological dream content to extract (no described scenes, locations, transitions, boundaries, or events). It does include author self-descriptions (born on cusp of 90s; raised on Nickelodeon/Disney Channel/playing outside; bookworm; 'gifted & talented'; feels 'different'; INTJ; poor relationship with parents; connected to spirituality/occult; frugal; prefers thrift store; rarely shops at mall) but these are not dream phenomenology fields in the schema.
